note: The canonical definitions are engine/agents/<id>.md. This registry is the machine-readable role index used by documentation, dispatch checks, and host installers. The implementer is the only writer; the verifier is read-only.

roles.purpose: task intake, project resolution, specialist selection, and the final decision
roles.when: every non-trivial task; coordinates and never writes code or bypasses the gate

roles.purpose: design and planning: compare approaches and map blast radius
roles.when: approach selection, large changes, regression-risk assessment
the implementation phase; exactly one implementer is active

roles.purpose: adversarial review: break the change, find missing tests and contract drift
independent verification: run the constrained gate and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED from the artifact
test design and test code only; cannot modify production code
roles.when: a regression test, fixture, or reproduction is needed

roles.purpose: profiling and benchmark comparison with measured numbers only
roles.when: a performance claim or regression needs evidence

roles.purpose: security, secrets, dependencies, and permission-boundary audit
roles.when: untrusted input, credentials, dependencies, or a permission change is in scope

roles.purpose: data provenance and claim verification: decide whether evidence supports the claim
roles.when: a claim needs a source, a hash, or a measured result behind it
